description: Gifts to streamers, top-ups in games
flavorText: Gifts to streamers, microtransactions in games. Your wallet never stood a chance.
You thought those extra seconds were worth it. The surveillance camera disagreed.

description: Need to liquidate assets to cover debts
effectDescription: Sell one property at 60% market value
flavorText: The pressure is mounting. You have no choice but to sell — the government buys at 60% of market value.

description: You and another player expose each other
flavorText: You tried to steal a slice of someone else's pie. Turns out they had the same idea. Nobody wins.
Nobody's maintained this place in years. Paint peeling, fixtures failing. The glory days are long gone.
All that running around finally caught up with you. This time, you have to stop.
